subject: ASSIGN render: guard legacy sampler consumers before exact factory goes live
body: Per textures' finding: once compute enables the exact sampler factory at device init, ordinary samplers can carry repeat/mip/aniso/compare/border state. Every legacy fixed-UI/compositor/R85 consumer in render_encoder.inc/compositor_submit.inc must call tegu_sampler_legacy_word_ok (or exact v2 path) and explicitly refuse otherwise — no silent field reduction. Add host test. Include in your current delta.
